en: Colorized scenic postcard view of a European city with a river in the foreground, lined by trees and multi‑story historic buildings. A bridge crosses the river toward a church tower and other urban structures. Behind the city rises a green hill crowned with fortifications and towers. In the background are soft, rolling mountains under a pale blue sky. At the top of the image the caption reads "Graz Mur, Schloßberg."
